text:
Iris (Partnerships): Quick sync: NVIDIA wants a co-certified bundle: their tensor-optimized runtimes + our Gateway + a LangChain connector demo. They want a joint announcement window in ~3 weeks and a short certification checklist. Can Eng and Sec estimate effort? cc @Ben @Hannah @Raj

Ben (Eng Runtime): sounds doable. engineering asks: 1) provide a microbench with their runtime (fp16/qat profiles), 2) confirm kernel compat for A100/A10, 3) a reproducible smoke-test script. I can produce the microbench and a docker sample. ETA 5 days for artifacts.

Hannah (Security): security review required for the bundled image + NVIDIA driver packaging. we'll need SBOMs from them + our supply-chain checklist. Also request: threat model for the orchestration webhook that LangChain will call.

Raj (Infra): infra note: marketplace listing requires a `cert_matrix.json` that declares supported HW (A100/A10/T4), tested configs, and performance targets. I can template that. Also we must gate the bundle behind a dedicated tenant mapping flow to isolate telemetry.

Iris (Partnerships): good. NVidia's PM said they'll share SBOM and a `driver-hash` for the image. They also want a one-page joint announcement blurb and logo assets for marketplace. @Vera can you draft?

Vera (Marketing): yep — can draft a short blurb once we have perf numbers and the one-liner. timeline: need copy by EOD Tue to hit a 3-week launch. Also request a 30s demo video plan.

Ben (Eng Runtime): paste for quickstart docker-compose (we'll keep small):
```
version: '3.7'
services:
  gateway:
    image: redwood/gateway:partner-canary
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_TENANT=nvidia-bundle-sandbox
      - WEBHOOK_SECRET=replace_me
    ports: ["8080:8080"]
  runtime:
    image: nvidia/runtime:optimized
    environment:
      - MODEL=llama-13b
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
```

Ben (Eng Runtime): and a minimal smoke-test curl to hit orchestration callback endpoint:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/orch/callback \\
  -H "X-Hub-Signature: sha256=..." \\
  -d '{"job_id":"test-123","status":"done"}'
```

Hannah (Security): for the webhook we require HMAC-SHA256 signatures and replay protection (nonce + timestamp). add a malformed-signature test to the smoke-suite.

nvidia-integration-bot: inbound: SBOM and image driver-hash uploaded to partner-share at 2024-12-02T14:03:22Z.

Raj (Infra): i will draft `cert_matrix.json` with fields: hw_supported, driver_hashes, test_steps, perf_targets. sending PR to partner repo today.

Iris (Partnerships): deliverables recap: Ben -> microbench results + docker quickstart + smoke-test (5d), Raj -> cert_matrix + tenant gating changes (3d), Hannah -> security checklist + webhook spec (2d), Vera -> draft copy (EOD Tue). NVIDIA will deliver SBOM & driver-hash. Once we have artifacts, we'll run a partner sandbox and then sign off for announcement.

release-bot: calendar: suggested launch windows: 2024-12-20 or 2025-01-10. Please confirm preferred date.

Vera (Marketing): leaning to 2024-12-20 (holidays tight, but co-marketing momentum helps). will prep assets once Ben's perf numbers land.

Iris (Partnerships): thanks team. I'll coordinate sandbox scheduling with NVIDIA and LangChain and post the partner-runbook link here when PRs are ready. :rocket:
